name: Storzen – Shop Builder for Elementor and WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Storzen is a powerful shop builder for Elementor and WooCommerce that lets you design stunning product displays without writing a single line of code. Replace boring default WooCommerce layouts with beautiful grids, sliders, tabbed sections, and list views — all built visually inside Elementor.

Whether you’re building a homepage product showcase, a landing page, or a full WooCommerce shop — Storzen gives you complete control over how your products look and convert.

Why Storzen?

Most WooCommerce stores look identical because they rely on default layouts. Storzen breaks that pattern. With native Elementor widgets, you can craft product sections that match your brand, engage your visitors, and drive more sales — in minutes, not days.

Key Features

Product Grid Layout
Display your WooCommerce products in fully customizable grid layouts. Control columns, spacing, image size, hover effects, and more — all from the Elementor panel. Perfect for shop pages, category pages, and homepages.

Product Carousel Slider
Showcase featured, trending, or new arrival products in a smooth, interactive carousel slider. Increase product visibility and keep visitors engaged longer on your store.

Tabbed Product Sections
Organize products into tabs — Latest, Best Sellers, Featured, or by Category — all in one widget. Let shoppers explore your catalog without leaving the page.

List View Layout
Present products in a detailed list format, ideal for stores where comparison and specification matter. Give your customers the information they need to buy with confidence.

Fully Responsive Design
Every layout built with Storzen looks perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile — automatically. No extra configuration or breakpoint headaches needed.

Smart Product Filtering
Display exactly the right products to the right audience. Filter by category, tag, featured status, best sellers, newest arrivals, and more — directly from the widget settings.

Native Elementor Integration
Storzen widgets appear natively inside your Elementor widget panel. Just drag, drop, and customize — it feels like a built-in Elementor feature from day one.

Zero Coding Required
Built for store owners, marketers, and designers. No PHP, no CSS, no shortcodes. If you can use Elementor, you can use Storzen.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store owners who want professional product layouts without hiring a developer
  • Elementor users looking for WooCommerce-specific widgets that go beyond the defaults
  • Designers & agencies building client stores who need fast, flexible product display options
  • Marketers creating high-converting WooCommerce landing pages and promotional campaigns

Use Cases

Homepage Product Sections
Greet your visitors with visually compelling product grids and sliders that immediately communicate your catalog and drive clicks.

Seasonal Campaigns & Promotions
Build targeted product showcases for sales, holidays, or new collections — launch in minutes with zero developer dependency.

Category Landing Pages
Create dedicated, high-converting pages for your top product categories using tabbed sections and custom grid layouts.

WooCommerce Product Showcases
Highlight collections, bundles, or curated picks with a focused, distraction-free product display that converts browsers into buyers.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce (latest version recommended)
  • Elementor (free version works)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Get Started in 3 Steps

  1. Install & activate WooCommerce and Elementor
  2. Install & activate Storzen
  3. Open any page in Elementor → find Storzen widgets in the panel → drag, drop, and publish your perfect WooCommerce shop

Build your best WooCommerce store today — install Storzen free.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce and Elementor are both installed and active.
  4. Open any page in Elementor and find Storzen widgets in the panel to start building.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor to use Storzen?

Yes. Storzen is built as an Elementor addon. You will need Elementor (free or pro) installed and active to use all widgets and features.

Does Storzen work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. Storzen is built exclusively for WooCommerce stores. WooCommerce must be installed and active for Storzen to function.

Is Storzen beginner-friendly?

Yes. Storzen requires zero coding knowledge. Everything is controlled visually through the Elementor drag-and-drop editor.

Can I display products by category or best sellers?

Yes. You can filter products by category, tag, featured status, best sellers, latest, and more — directly inside each widget’s settings panel.

Does Storzen slow down my site?

No. Storzen is built with performance in mind — clean code, minimal assets, and no unnecessary scripts loaded on pages where widgets are not used.

Is Storzen mobile responsive?

Yes. Every layout created with Storzen is fully responsive out of the box and adapts automatically to all screen sizes.

Does Storzen work with all WordPress themes?

Storzen works with any well-coded WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce and Elementor — including Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Hello Elementor, Kadence, and more.

Where can I get support?

Free support is available via the official WordPress.org support forum for this plugin. We aim to respond within 24–48 hours.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Renamed plugin to Storzen – Shop Builder for Elementor and WooCommerce
  • Updated plugin slug to storzen
  • Updated all internal prefixes from WCSB_ / wcommero_ to STZN_ / storzen_
  • Updated text domain to storzen throughout all files
  • Updated PHP namespace to DevHasib\Storzen\Elementor
  • Updated Elementor widget category and filter hooks

1.0.3

  • Fixed inline style output to use wp_add_inline_style()
  • Fixed Elementor widget namespaces to avoid collision with Elementor core namespace
  • Added Requires Plugins header for WooCommerce and Elementor
  • Documented all third-party libraries in readme

1.0.0

  • Initial release
